places.name: Dom Tower
places.ai_summary: The tallest church tower in the Netherlands, offering panoramic views of Utrecht and its surroundings.
places.place_tip: Climb the tower for breathtaking views of the city.

attribution.title: DomTorenUtrechtNederland
attribution.author: Massimo Catarinella
attribution.description: The Dom Tower in Utrecht, the Netherlands is one of the best known landmarks of this country. This gothic tower is the highest church tower (112,5 metres/368 feet) in the Netherlands and was built between 1321 and 1382 as part of the Cathedral of St. Martin. The resolution of the original photograph is 7768*4150.

places.name: Museum Speelklok
places.ai_summary: A unique museum showcasing self-playing musical instruments, from music boxes to orchestrions.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the guided tour to see the instruments in action.

attribution.description: De Buurkerk en de Domtoren in de Utrechtse binnenstad, met reclameposters voor het Museum van Speelklok tot Pierement dat daar gevestigd is.

places.name: Rietveld Schröder House
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and a masterpiece of modern architecture designed by Gerrit Rietveld.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking required for guided tours.

places.place_tip: Explore the innovative design features of this architectural gem.

places.name: Centraal Museum
places.ai_summary: The main museum of Utrecht, featuring a diverse collection of art, history, and culture.
places.place_tip: Visit the museum café for a break with a view.

places.name: Railway Museum
places.ai_summary: A fascinating museum dedicated to the history of railways in the Netherlands, with interactive exhibits and historic trains.

opening_hours.notes: Plan for a half-day visit to explore the museum and grounds.

places.place_tip: Take the train from Utrecht to the museum for a complete railway experience.

places.name: Botanic Gardens Utrecht
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and diverse garden featuring plants from around the world, located at Utrecht University.
places.place_tip: Visit the rock garden and the tropical greenhouse.

places.name: De Haar Castle
places.ai_summary: A stunning medieval castle with impressive architecture, beautiful gardens, and a rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Check website for special events and exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Explore the castle interiors and the surrounding parkland.

places.ai_summary: The cathedral is known for its impressive Gothic architecture and beautiful stained glass windows.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to climb the tower for a stunning view of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Check website for events and exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Stroll through the gardens and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.

places.ai_summary: A large shopping mall in Utrecht, offering a wide range of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options.

places.name: Nijntje Museum
places.ai_summary: A charming museum dedicated to the beloved Dutch cartoon character Nijntje (Miffy), featuring interactive exhibits for children.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for families with young children.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique Nijntje souvenirs.

places.name: Wilhelminapark
places.ai_summary: A lovely city park with walking paths, a pond, and a playground, perfect for a relaxing stroll or a picnic.

opening_hours.notes: Popular spot for locals and tourists alike.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy it by the pond.

places.name: TivoliVredenburg Concert Hall
places.ai_summary: A modern concert hall in Utrecht, known for its excellent acoustics and diverse music program.
